notes: H2 uptake measured on a Micromeritics ASAP 2020 at 76 K (liquid nitrogen bath), up to about 1.1 atm, for FCNFs-I to IV (Fig. 12, Table 3) and UFCNFs (Fig. 11); the paper does not use the word volumetric, but the instrument is a static gas-dosing adsorption analyser calibrated with He (Section 2.2.3 names N2 and He for the sorption apparatus), so I1 is read as a volumetric method. Section 2.2.6 reports electrochemical capacitance in 0.5 M H2SO4, which is not hydrogen charging in an electrolyte and does not make the paper electrochemical; the H2 uptake is gas-phase. Sorbents are carbon nanofibers from pyrolysed sucrose in an SBA-15 template (silica removed with HF), functionalised with HNO3 (COOH 3.5 to 6.6 %), so carbon is the majority component. Surface areas (BET, N2 at 76 K) are from the same samples. Minor inconsistency: Section 3.3.1 text says areas decreased from 775 to 476 m2 g-1 while Table 1 gives 810 to 451; does not affect eligibility. Retraction flag false in record.json; no retraction notice in the text; no statement that H2 values were published before; research article with data.
